shorts_extract.hook: Why a hot shower 10 minutes before bed keeps you tossing—while the exact same shower 90 minutes earlier switches on deep sleep.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Haghayegh et al. (2019, UT Austin) & Tai et al. (2021, 1,094 adults): 10 minutes at 40–42.5 °C timed 1–2 hours pre-bed opens palm-and-sole radiators to cool your core.
shorts_extract.twist: Your brain needs core temperature to drop to fall asleep—and warm hands and feet predict sleep speed even better than melatonin (Kräuchi et al., 1999, Nature).
